204.description: The step runs its authored connector.

401.description: No bearer token, or the token fails signature, issuer, audience or expiry verification.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.
schema.title: NestHttpError

403.description: The token verifies but its `roles` claim holds none of `ADMIN_REQUIRED_ROLES`; signing in again cannot fix this.

schema.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.

404.description: `WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND`: No published workflow has this id, or no revision of it carries the pinned version.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

503.description: Entra's signing key set could not be reached, so the token was never judged. Retry.
